title: English Practice Quiz 0969
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A career objective describes ___.
questions.explanation: A career objective states a professional aim.

questions.question: A transferable skill is one that ___.
options: can be used in different roles or industries
works only on one specific machine
questions.explanation: Transferable skills apply across different jobs and settings.

questions.question: Constructive criticism is intended to ___.
questions.explanation: Constructive criticism offers feedback aimed at improvement.

questions.question: A professional portfolio is a collection of ___.
questions.explanation: A portfolio demonstrates experience, skills and completed work.

questions.question: A probation period is generally used to ___.
questions.explanation: Probation allows an employer and employee to assess the working arrangement.

questions.question: To 'upskill' means to ___.
questions.explanation: Upskilling develops skills for current or future work.

questions.question: A realistic performance goal should be ___.
questions.explanation: Clear, measurable goals make progress easier to evaluate.

questions.question: A reference from a former employer may describe your ___.
questions.explanation: Employment references commonly comment on work history and conduct.

questions.question: Networking in a professional context means ___.
questions.explanation: Professional networking builds relationships that can support learning and work.

questions.question: After completing a training course, applying the new skills helps ___.
questions.explanation: Practice helps turn new knowledge into usable skills.
